sources.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Powering real-world robotics tasks through enhanced embodied reasoning
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The April 14 launch explicitly compares ER 1.6 with ER 1.5 and Gemini 3.0 Flash and describes embodied-reasoning tasks. It supplies no nominal total, active or component parameter count; benchmark percentages, robot payload examples and latency are not weight counts. Original same-day availability evidence is unchanged.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-card reread confirms the explicit Gemini 3.0 Flash base and architecture reference. The text describes additional embodied-reasoning training, with no numeric total, active, vision-component or other component size. This is a valid named-base relationship in principle, but the referenced Flash model has no published count in the inspected sources.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview table confirms preview variant, 131,072 input tokens, text/image/video/audio inputs, text output, Thinking Supported and Function calling Supported. Page updated October 8, 2026; its separate Latest update December 2025 cell conflicts with the release announcement. The Versions row marks this preview as shut down. Reopened October 27 for the parameter re-audit: the exact preview specification table contains no numerical total or active model count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-card inspection. Gemini 3 Flash explicitly names Gemini 3 Pro as its dependency and architecture source. Neither architecture nor evaluation/safety comparisons provide a numerical total or active count. This named base chain supplies no known size for ER 1.6 to inherit.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-card inspection, including architecture and comparison tables. The Pro model describes sparse MoE routing without expert dimensions, routing width, total or active size. It is explicitly a new model rather than a fine-tune of a prior model; no further count-bearing base is identified.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms effective March 23, 2026 govern Gemini API and AI Studio access, impose use restrictions, and prohibit extracting or replicating underlying model parameter weights. Supports proprietary hosted-access classification, rather than treating page-content or code-example licenses as model licenses.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 complete later-card check. The July ER 2 model explicitly depends on Gemini 3.5 Flash, distinct from ER 1.6’s Gemini 3.0 Flash base. Its architecture and comparison material supply no retrospective total or active count for ER 1.6.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini Robotics ER 2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The July 30 successor announcement compares exact ER 1.6 benchmark results against ER 2 but has no parameter-size or activated-parameter column. A successor’s capabilities and different named base do not establish a count for ER 1.6.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics 2: Safety Technical Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 inspection of the complete 58,181-character report text for exact-model and parameter references. It supplies no ER 1.6 total or active count; its parameterization terminology concerns task ambiguity, not model weight size. No other robotics model specification is transferred.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.evidence: Robotics table explicitly lists gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview release April 14, 2026, shutdown date August 31, 2026, and replacement ER 2 Preview. Page cautions shutdown dates are earliest possible dates.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER overview
sources.evidence: Current overview states ER 1.6 was deprecated August 31, 2026 and recommends switching the exact API identifier to ER 2. Specifications in this audit are documented ER 1.6 behavior, not proof that its endpoint still operates.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full-text parameter and robotics-name review. Robotics comparisons concern Gemini Robotics ER 2, with no retrospective ER 1.6 numerical size. Parameter mentions concern evaluation difficulty, weight security and encoded knowledge rather than total or activated counts.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 Model Card, April 2026 PDF
sources.evidence: Followed the original card’s PDF link and read all four pages on October 27. It confirms the explicit Gemini 3.0 Flash base and additional embodied-reasoning training. It contains no numeric complete, active or component count; evaluation sections refer to release-post benchmark figures rather than a size table.

name.note: Developer card names ER 1.6; exact API model table identifies the preview variant.

developer.note: Developed and announced by Google DeepMind; Google is the existing catalog developer grouping.

family.note: The exact card explicitly places this model in the Gemini 3.0 family.

release_date.note: Same-day API availability in the launch and exact-ID release table agree. April 20 is model-card publication, not first release. The API table's December 2025 Latest update cell does not override these explicit release sources.

open_weights.note: Developer distributes this model through hosted Gemini API/AI Studio access under restrictive service terms; no public weights are provided in the reviewed release sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access under Google service terms, not an SPDX license. Documentation and sample-code licenses do not license the weights.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name/ID total-size, named-base and component searches, reopened original evidence and later primary comparisons found no supported nominal total. ER 1.6 explicitly depends on Gemini 3 Flash, which names Gemini 3 Pro; neither base has a published count to inherit. No scoped component count was found either. Null reflects absent numerical evidence, not an exact tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated-count searches and original/later comparison checks found no numerical active size for ER 1.6 or its named bases. Sparse routing is documented without expert dimensions or routing quantities sufficient for a count. Benchmark scores, API settings and robot-control task parameters are not active weights; no component or phase count is published.

architecture.note: Explicit architecture-reference chain: ER 1.6 directs to Gemini 3 Flash, which directs to Gemini 3 Pro; the terminal card states sparse MoE Transformer. This supports the architectural class, not inherited numeric sizes or context limits.

context_window.note: Exact preview API table gives an input token limit of 131,072; the model card rounds this to 128k.

modalities.note: The exact model card and endpoint table agree on all four input modalities and text-only output.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly supported in the exact preview endpoint table.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint table supports function calling; launch describes native third-party function calls.

description.value: Vision-language model based on Gemini 3.0 Flash for spatial reasoning, task planning, success detection, and instrument reading in robotics.
description.note: Replaces broad agentic wording with the documented base model and concrete robotics tasks.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer based on Gemini 3 Flash, whose card names Gemini 3 Pro as its base. Total and active parameter counts are undisclosed for ER 1.6 and its named bases. These are historical preview specifications: Google marks the endpoint as shut down and lists August 31, 2026 as its shutdown date.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit completed October 27, 2026. Exact-model/ID, total, active and component searches, original HTML/PDF cards and API/launch evidence, the named Flash/Pro base chain, and later robotics/Argon comparisons found no supported numerical count. Both nulls are explicit; named-base inference is valid in principle but no base size is published. All unrelated field assessments and existing corrections are preserved.
